quiet_recomputed_from_raw_samples.raw_tail_interpretation: After wait4 reaps the solver, its /proc entry is absent. The raw tail incorrectly attributes remaining solver CPU to aggregate unassigned work. The controller uses wait4 CPU accounting to correct this final interval; raw tail.aggregate_contamination alone is therefore not the final acceptance criterion.

protocol.timed_scope: fresh direct process envelope: Popen through wait4; includes loader/startup and shutdown; excludes original audit and quiet waits
protocol.historical_time_scope_note: Historical envelopes differ by producer and include their respective startup wrappers; no historical startup subtraction is applied.
protocol.ordering: pairs hashed with seed 20261110; alternating modes per pair; repetition 2 reverses modes; repetition 3 rotates fixed pair order
protocol.invalid_environment_policy: keep raw attempt; do not commit nominal repetition; wait for quiet, then retry that same nominal repetition
protocol.numerical_failure_policy: commit first finalized uncontaminated attempt, including numerical failure or exhausted budget; never retry to obtain success
protocol.foreign_observation_scope: all /proc processes and aggregate CPU counters on every online CPU, including cores 22 and 23; no foreign process is stopped
protocol.intervention: same deterministic R3 correction; rebuild at each model reanchor event, including repeated centers; reuse constructs once per model instance
protocol.controls: unpatched reference, patched reuse and patched rebuild from identical raw starts; exact original endpoint/work, ordered correction/state traces and original audits
protocol.trace_policy: qualification only; report sidecar in all patched runs; no fingerprint or trajectory trace in timed repetitions

limitations: Full endpoint vectors and original QCQP input files are not included in this export. This review checks retained reports and bindings, not a new original-KKT evaluation.
Quiet CPU observations are thresholded sampling and aggregate CPU accounting. They do not exclude idle processes, I/O wait or non-CPU contention.
The unmodified and patched solver binaries are named and fingerprinted in retained build records but are not rerun in this review.
